articles.title: Mehbooba Mufti, Mirwaiz Umar Farooq renew call for India-Pakistan dialogue for resolution of all issues including J&K
articles.summary: Former J&K Chief Minister Mehbooba Mufti and Mirwaiz Umar Farooq have reiterated their call for dialogue between India and Pakistan. They stressed that such initiatives are essential for resolving long-standing issues and fostering regional peace and stability. This appeal reflects ongoing political discourse within Jammu and Kashmir, underscoring the perceived importance of diplomatic engagement to improve bilateral relations and ensure progress in the region.

articles.title: MLB Owners Want A Salary Cap To Protect Themselves From Themselves
articles.summary: New York Mets owner Steve Cohen, having signed Juan Soto to a staggering $765 million contract, is now among owners advocating for a league-wide salary cap. This move, despite Cohen's voluntary expenditure, aims to prevent future colossal player deals. Owners seek to control spiraling costs, ensuring financial stability and competitive balance across the professional sports league.

articles.title: Conan O’Brien reveals overlooked male menopause change that surprised him
articles.summary: The article discusses age-related hormonal changes, specifically 'Andropause' (male menopause), often a less-talked-about phenomenon. Understanding such physiological processes is crucial for overall well-being and general awareness.

articles.title: Is Japan a Model Middle Power?
articles.summary: Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney's speech at the World Economic Forum re-emphasized the "middle power" concept. Amidst hints of U.S. President Trump asserting global dominance, Carney proposed that countries like Canada collaborate to influence international affairs. This strategy aims to promote multilateralism, balance power dynamics among major nations, and collectively address global challenges, offering a counterpoint to unilateralist tendencies.

articles.title: 星のカービィの『Kirby Cafe (カービィカフェ)』にて「カービィカフェ Summer 2026」を7月8日(水)より期間限定で開催！“かいふくアイテム”をテーマにしたメニューや新作グッズが登場
articles.summary: The popular Kirby Café will open temporary locations in Tokyo, Osaka, and Hakata, Japan, from July 8 to September 23, 2026. Celebrating 'Summer 2026,' the themed café, based on the iconic Nintendo character, will offer fans a unique experience.
